The key fits, but the data itself would not open, for example after a failed update. Nothing was deleted. Try again. If it keeps failing, you can set the old data aside and start fresh.

SMS works without the internet. An SMS to one person is the surest: several numbers at once may go as an MMS, which needs mobile data. The app opens; press Send there.

Make the plan together. Everyone should know it by heart; keep a paper copy too, as phones run out of power.
If you must leave the building
If you cannot stay near home
If the town must be left
A relative in another town or country whom everyone calls when they cannot reach each other.
Write it plainly: “if… then…”. Such a plan is easier to remember and follow.
e.g. we go to the corridor, the bag is by the door
e.g. takes the bag and turns off the gas
Twice a year walk the routes to the shelter and the meeting points, by day and in the evening.
The list from the guide. Tick what is already in the bag. Each adult needs their own bag.
Twice a year check expiry dates of food and medicines and charge the power banks.
Start small: three days is a goal anyone can reach. Then two weeks, then a month.
4 litres a person a day: 2 to drink, 2 for cooking and washing.
Buy what you usually eat, 20–30% more than the norm, and put new stock at the back: then nothing expires.

Write the number with the country code, e.g. +380…, or as 0XXXXXXXXX: otherwise WhatsApp may open the wrong chat.
Blood group, allergies, medicines, contact as a QR code

QR code with your key medical facts

You can set the picture as the lock screen in the phone settings. Then anyone can see it without unlocking the phone.

Plan, medical card and contacts on paper
Phones run out of power. Keep a paper copy at home and in the bag.
Personal. Keep it where strangers cannot see it.

Anyone who gets the file can read your medical data and plan. If you save it to a folder that syncs to a cloud, it will be copied there too. Save it only where you decide, and delete it after printing if it is not needed.

The phone’s own camera takes the picture; Sprotyv reads the code on the phone and deletes its copy. Some camera apps also keep a copy in the gallery: check and delete it there if needed. Nothing opens without your choice.

No QR code found. Take the photo closer and in good light.
Fake codes are stuck on top of real ones. Open only if you trust the address.

All your data in one encrypted file

A copy of all your data and settings (look, tiles, theme) in one file, encrypted with a password. On a new phone: “Move from another phone”, the file, the password — and all is as it was. Without the password nobody can open it, not even us. Keep it apart from the phone: on a USB stick, a computer or in the cloud.
Working… This takes a few seconds.
The password is six random words. Write it on paper and keep it apart from the phone.
Too simple: at least 16 characters, without common words or keyboard rows.
I have written the password down
Written only into a new file and checked at once. A forgotten password cannot be recovered.
On a new phone, for example. The backup replaces everything now in “Mine”.
Backup from %1$s: people — %2$d, records in all — %3$d. Everything now in “Mine” will be replaced.
That did not work. Nothing changed; please try again.

Wrong password, or the file is damaged. Check the keyboard layout and stray letters or spaces.

This is not a Sprotyv backup, or the file is damaged.

An encrypted code for a relative\'s phone
A relative points Sprotyv\'s camera at this code and types the password. The whole family plan is then on their phone.
The password is four words. Say it aloud; never send it with the code.
Fill in the family plan first.

For a child aged 6–10: pictures, a call to family and 112
On a child\'s phone, turn on the settings lock so the look is not changed by accident.
The child will see seven pictures with short tips, a “Call my family” button and 112. Add family numbers in “Trusted people” in the full look. Locking the settings with the phone\'s PIN is advised.
No numbers here yet. Ask a grown-up to add them.
Who do you want to call?
Something bad happened and your family does not answer: call 112. Say your name, your address and what happened.
I\'m Sunny. Tap a picture and I\'ll tell you what to do.
Now you know what to do.
Off: 112 and the other services open from the red phone at the top of every screen.
I need help. Call or write as soon as you can.
I can\'t talk, but I\'m reachable. Write, don\'t call.

Write this time with a marker on the tourniquet or the casualty\'s forehead. Never loosen it: only a medic removes it. Tell the medics the time. Several wounded: write the time on each tourniquet — the phone may run flat.
Threat and front-line maps, fact checks
An alert means: to the shelter at once. Do not wait for a target to appear near you on the map.
No mark near you does not mean no danger. The data comes late, and ballistic missiles are not on the maps.
Do not film or post air defence at work or strikes as they happen: it helps the enemy, and people have been convicted for it.
Sources: Ministry of Defence (17.10.2026), Kyiv City Administration, Survival guide 3.3. Checked 30.10.2026.
Sprotyv itself downloads nothing: pages open in the browser or in the source\'s own app. List checked 30.10.2026.

Chrome on this phone opens these pages in a separate tab: after closing it keeps no history, cookies or cache. The site and the mobile operator still see the visit. The sources\' own apps keep their data as usual.
Your browser keeps these pages in its history, like any others. If that is a concern, install Firefox Focus (Sprotyv will then open pages in it) or use the browser\'s private mode.
Pages open in Firefox Focus. When done, tap the bin (Erase) in it: until you do, the pages stay in Focus. The site and the mobile operator see the visit; the sources\' own apps keep their data.
Firefox Focus on this phone was not installed from Google Play, so Sprotyv does not use it: pages open in the main browser and stay in its history.
Find your oblast and open your grid operator\'s site: the schedule for your queue is there. Emergency cuts can happen outside the schedule.
Addresses checked against Glavcom\'s list of 17.10.2026. Use schedule bots only from links on your operator\'s own site: fake bots are common.
Checked services and organisations for life during and after the war. Each says who runs it; phone numbers dial in one tap.
The list is checked every month. No official service asks for money for help or \"information\": that is a sign of fraud.

Tap, and Sprotyv will count the time and tell you how long the fridge and freezer still keep cold.
Over 4 hours without power: throw away meat, fish, eggs and milk from the fridge.
The freezer no longer keeps cold: check the food before eating it.
Keep the fridge and freezer shut unless needed: the cold lasts longer.
Rough figures. The real power of a device is on its label or charger. In the cold and with an old battery there is less charge.
%1$d minutes have passed. A repeated strike can come even after 1–2 hours: take care, listen for the all-clear.

On by default: the screen can be captured everywhere, and a strip at the top of every “Mine” screen reminds you. Turned off, the medical card, people, plan and supplies do not show in screenshots, screen recordings, casting or the recent apps list (another phone’s camera is not stopped). Cards and the guide can always be captured.

Screenshots and screen recordings are saved to the gallery unencrypted and may end up in a cloud backup or other apps. Assistants, on-screen search, casting and screen sharing can also see and record the screen, and some send it to the internet; the recent apps list will show your data too. Turn this off again when done: while it is on, a strip at the top of every “Mine” screen says so.

Version: %1$s

What happened or what you would like:

Sprotyv\'s GitHub page opens (an account is needed). The text is passed there when the page opens and stays in the browser history; it is published only after you confirm, and shows your account name. Nothing from “Mine” goes there. If being linked to the app could put you at risk, do not send.
Last time Sprotyv closed with an error

You can send a technical description of the error to help fix it. It holds only the error\'s name, places in the code and the app and Android versions, none of your data. The text is passed to a public GitHub page when it opens; it is published only after you confirm.
Show “My readiness” on the home screen
On the phone\'s home screen and in the recent apps list, Sprotyv is called “Notes” with a plain icon.

You may need to add the home-screen icon again: look for “Notes”. Remember this — in danger the app must be found fast. It is not a hiding place: the open app looks like Sprotyv, and the phone\'s settings still call it Sprotyv. Remove Sprotyv\'s widgets and pinned shortcuts from the home screen, if there are any.

For when the phone may end up in the wrong hands: leaving occupied areas, a threat of capture or abduction, theft. Hides “Mine” (medical card, people, plan, supplies), “I am safe”, front maps, the search for prisoners and the missing, veterans\' services, war crimes and human rights, deported children, papers from the occupied areas and care for the wounded. Turning it off needs the phone\'s PIN (or nothing, if the phone\'s screen lock is removed). The guide stays.
First set a screen lock on the phone (PIN or password): without it anyone could turn trip mode off.

Nothing hidden is deleted: the data stays encrypted on the phone. Anyone who makes you unlock the phone and enter the PIN can turn the mode off and see it. Before a trip, think about what you really need to carry, and make a backup. Cards, the guide and 112 work as usual. Settings show the mode is on, so a careful look will tell something is hidden.
Open “Mine” with a fingerprint or PIN

Off by default, so the medical card and “I am safe” open at once in danger. When on, “Mine” opens only after the phone\'s fingerprint or PIN, every time; without it the key to the data does not work at all. Cards, the guide and 112 open as usual.
A fingerprint does not work at all: a finger can be forced onto the sensor, a PIN has to be told.
First set a screen lock on the phone (PIN or password).

Each time you open the medical card, people, plan or “I am safe”, you will confirm with a fingerprint or PIN. Important: if the phone\'s screen lock is removed, the key becomes unusable and the data will not open again. Make a backup first.

At −5…−10° outside, pipes freeze in 1–3 days. If the heat does not come back, drain the pipes, the boiler and the water heater.

The whole of Ministry of Health order No. 441 in one place: the order and its 29 official procedures, what to do before the ambulance comes. Each procedure reads as steps or as the full text. The order’s words are not changed.

What anyone can do, where to learn, service 18+

The one who can stop bleeding. The one who knows the family plan and stays calm. The neighbour who checks the news before passing it on. The community that keeps an Invincibility Point running. Volunteers bringing generators. That is resistance too, and it starts with one skill.
Pick one thing this week and do it.

State programmes and civic organisations side by side: the country holds on both. Resistance training centres exist in many regions: look for yours on the regional council’s or military administration’s site. Each says who runs it.
How to support yourself and others when it is frightening, and not fall for manipulation.
Show how joining the service works
Only facts from official sources, rights and risks. The decision is yours alone.
You can serve under contract or through mobilisation. Recruitment lets you choose a unit and a post that fits your skills.
Ages 18–25: contract only: a short 1–2 year contract, a one-off payment of UAH 1 million and a year’s deferral after service.
The way in: vacancy → interview → the commander’s letter of recommendation → medical board and psychological test (referral in Reserv+) → 51 days of basic training → the unit that gave the letter.
A letter from a priority unit guarantees service there; others need the General Staff’s approval. Ask the recruiter whether the unit is on the list.
Service means risk to life and health. If your rights are violated: the recruiter, the Ministry of Defence hotline 1512, the Office of the Military Ombudsman.
Source: Ministry of Defence, “A conscious choice: how recruitment works in 2026”, 04.03.2026. Checked 31.10.2026. Terms change: check with a recruiter.

Small daily actions that add strength to you and those close to you. Take up to five and tick what is done. A missed day resets nothing.

Movement every day and a check once a month
Is the body ready — once a month
Not a score, a guide: what may be needed in danger.

With heart or joint conditions, pregnancy or a recent injury, ask a doctor what load suits you. WHO guide for adults: 150–300 minutes of moderate movement a week and strength exercises on at least two days a week; after 65, balance exercises on 3 days too. Any movement is better than none.
A habit mostly becomes automatic in about 66 days, from 18 to more than 200 depending on the person and the habit. So days done are counted here, not an unbroken streak.
One missed day hardly affects how a habit forms — so nothing is reset.
An \"if — then\" plan tied to something you already do every day makes you noticeably more likely to actually do it.
The first five groups follow the five supports that help people hold on after disasters: safety, calm, belief that you and your community can act, connection, and hope. The sixth is the body.
Your habits, steps and roles. A small thing each day adds strength to you and to those around you.
Your ticks are kept encrypted in Mine and are sent nowhere.
